lines.en: I walk on air; touching the ground is beneath me.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我向前滑了一截。
lines.en: One swing of my tail and I glide forward.

lines.zh: 这片天地的重力，对我没用。
lines.en: This world's gravity does nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢踱着，让他们先怕。
lines.en: I stroll slowly and let the fear build first.

lines.zh: 飞起来比走路省力得多。
lines.en: Flying is so much less effort than walking.

lines.zh: 我悬在地面上方一寸处。
lines.en: I hover an inch above the ground.

lines.zh: 脚尖轻点，尘土自动让开。
lines.en: My toe brushes down and the dust clears itself.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，看看谁在发抖。
lines.en: I circle once to see who is trembling.

lines.zh: 身后拖着一道白色的气。
lines.en: A white trail of ki drags behind me.
I skim along the ridgeline.
That distance is one blink away.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边整理肩甲。
lines.en: Walking, I straighten my shoulder armor.

lines.zh: 我收着气，等他们自己上来。
lines.en: I bank my ki and wait for them to come to me.
The armor is off. I am taking this seriously now.

lines.zh: 站在这块石头上，风景不错。
lines.en: A fine view from this rock.

lines.zh: 我的气在脚下压碎了石面。
lines.en: My ki crushes the stone under my feet.
I watch the distance and count the time.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽了一下，有点无聊。
lines.en: My tail flicks. I am a little bored.

lines.zh: 我笑得很轻，他们听不见。
lines.en: I laugh softly where they cannot hear.

lines.zh: 这个星球的空气，太稠了。
lines.en: The air on this planet is too thick.
Hands clasped behind me, I stand.
No clouds above. I approve.
I lift a hand and inspect my nails.

lines.zh: 气焰低了一寸，我懒得管。
lines.en: The aura dips an inch. I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我听见远处的脚步，没转身。
lines.en: I hear footsteps far off and do not turn.
I hold this battlefield first.
Oh, another one come to die.
I can see your power level.
Do not tremble. It looks pathetic.
You think you have a chance?
I suggest you kneel. It will be easier.
I do like that look in your eyes.

lines.zh: 这身肌肉，挡不住一根手指。
lines.en: Those muscles will not stop one finger.

lines.zh: 你身上有赛亚人的味道。
lines.en: You smell of Saiyan.
I permit you to speak.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖在抖，我看得清楚。
lines.en: Your knees are shaking. I see it clearly.
Do not watch me. Watch my finger.
Standing there like that is almost brave.
I smile because you are too slow.
I will let you finish speaking first.
You even hesitate to lift your head.

lines.zh: 你的武器在我看来是玩具。
lines.en: Your weapon looks like a toy to me.
A few more of you would change nothing.
I will count to three and you will move.
This blood has soiled my hand.
A scratch at most.
I bank my ki and steady my feet.
Interesting. You are stronger than I thought.
My armor has split along one line.
Pain? I forgot that word long ago.
I breathe in and the aura burns brighter.
Blood at my lip. I lick it away.
You have made me a little serious.
I will return that blow to you.

lines.zh: 一亿两千万的战力，够看吗。
lines.en: A hundred twenty million; is that enough?
That smell... mildly interesting.
I have tasted far better.
Bring it here and I might indulge.

lines.zh: 你们连吃饭都这么认真。
lines.en: You people are so earnest about eating.

lines.zh: 这条鱼，配不上我的席面。
lines.en: That fish is beneath my table.

lines.zh: 我咬一口，只是出于好奇。
lines.en: I take a bite purely out of curiosity.
Mediocre. I spat it out.
Do not try to bribe me with food.
My appetite is much larger than this.
You touched me. That is serious.
That impact was a breeze.
Back away. Do not soil my armor.
That hurt you more than me, did it not?
My aura pushed you off.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就当你挑衅。
lines.en: Once more and I take it as a challenge.
Collisions of this level bore me.
You cannot even keep your footing.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬下巴，让你过去。
lines.en: I lift my chin and let you pass.
Not so close. You are noisy.

lines.zh: 这种软弱的事，与我无关。
lines.en: Such weakness is no concern of mine.
I rule. I need no consort.
Attachment slows the strong.

lines.zh: 我父亲也从未教过我这个。
lines.en: My father never taught me this either.

lines.zh: 有人愿意靠近我，我不敢信。
lines.en: Someone choosing to come near me. I do not trust it.

lines.zh: 宇宙里没有配得上我的。
lines.en: There is no one in the universe worthy.

lines.zh: 孤独？那是强者该付的价。
lines.en: Loneliness? That is the price of strength.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴不会交给任何人。
lines.en: My tail will not be handed to anyone.
Do not speak of such things before me.
I cherish only power.

lines.zh: 这种东西，也配进我的手？
lines.en: This thing, in my hand?
I pinch it up, look, and drop it.
This ore is passably solid.
Things off the ground are beneath me.
I pick it up only to know what it is.
This little ball looks familiar.

lines.zh: 我把它捏碎了，没别的意思。
lines.en: I crush it. No particular reason.
Into my collection, then.
Inspecting the spoils is a pleasure.
Your things come to me eventually.

lines.zh: 我伸出一根手指，你就退了两步。
lines.en: One finger raised, and you stepped back twice.
My ki has found you.
At this range you will be entertaining.
His ki is rising. Interesting.
I extend one finger.
Target confirmed. No further questions.
Standing there is your answer.
I have already read his motion.

lines.zh: 躲得掉这一下，也能躲第二下？
lines.en: Dodge this, but what of the next?
His feet are backing away.
Then I will stop being polite.
Such courage deserves encouragement.
I smile. The target is set.
You think moving first gives you an edge?
All of you are included.
I am counting how many are left.
He keeps backing and finds no exit.
My ki pins him in place.
He raised a hand. I wait.
I have seen this technique too often.
I drift back and forth and let him panic.
His breathing keeps falling apart.
No hurry. Prey tires.
He searches for an opening. There is none.

lines.zh: 那一下预判，我早料到了。
lines.en: That feint was predicted long ago.
I raise my hand to shoulder height.
He shifts half a step; so do I.
This one is tougher than he looks.

lines.zh: 我盯着他的膝盖，那里会先软。
lines.en: I watch his knees. They will give first.

lines.zh: 他开始喘了，快到最后了。
lines.en: He is gasping. Nearly done.
I drift around to his rear quarter.

lines.zh: 他手里那口气，还差点火候。
lines.en: Whatever he is gathering lacks the last bit.

lines.zh: 我让他先出招，也算礼貌。
lines.en: I let him strike first. Call it courtesy.

lines.zh: 这一局，我从一开始就赢着。
lines.en: I have been winning since the start.
The light at my fingertip goes straight through him.
My kick lands square on his chest.
My fist arrives before he sees it.
Three hits and he is still airborne.
My tail whips the back of his neck.
A small ki blast. Barely an effort.

lines.zh: 我抓住他的手腕，压下去。
lines.en: I catch his wrist and force it down.
My knee rams his stomach.
I drive him into the cliff face.
The Destructo Disc comes in from the side.
I flick his blade away with one hand.

lines.zh: 这一拳，我只用了半分力。
lines.en: That punch was half my strength.

lines.zh: 他从天上掉下去，又爬起来。
lines.en: He falls from the sky and rises again.
I follow and drive him down with my heel.
A Death Ball bursts at his feet.
His armor shatters and I laugh.

lines.zh: 我从云里降下来，慢慢落地。
lines.en: I descend through the clouds and settle slowly.

lines.zh: 我的气先到了，人还没到。
lines.en: My ki arrives before I do.
This sky is mine from today.
I shed the armor and roll my shoulders.

lines.zh: 一百万，一百二十万，随你算。
lines.en: A hundred million. A hundred twenty. Count it yourself.
I came alone. That is enough.
The wind drops under my pressure.
Stones begin to lift.

lines.zh: 我站在半空，俯视这片地。
lines.en: I stand in the air and look down on this land.

lines.zh: 笑一个吧，好戏要开始了。
lines.en: Do smile. The show is starting.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，骨头在响。
lines.en: I stretch and my joints crack.

lines.zh: 他们还在找我，我就在头顶。
lines.en: They are still searching. I am overhead.
White aura wraps around me.

lines.zh: 我轻轻落在一块岩石上。
lines.en: I settle lightly on a boulder.

lines.zh: 空气变重了，你们感觉到了吧。
lines.en: The air grows heavy. You feel it, do you not?
I need no reason to make an entrance.
This plain gives a fine view.
I curl my tail around my leg.

lines.zh: 火焰烧到我的肩，我皱眉。
lines.en: Fire scorches my shoulder and I frown.

lines.zh: 我从高空落下，砸出个坑。
lines.en: I fall from high up and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 水压住了我的气，真难受。
lines.en: Water presses my ki down. Unpleasant.

lines.zh: 那团爆炸把我推开了几丈。
lines.en: That blast shoved me back several yards.
Something struck my arm.
Strange force is tangling my ki.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，也不该虚弱。
lines.en: I do not eat. I should not weaken.

lines.zh: 雷光劈在我身上，麻了一阵。
lines.en: Lightning hit me and my body went numb.

lines.zh: 我被拽进了没有气的地方。
lines.en: I am pulled into a place with no ki at all.
